text:
nina (Finance): FYI: short update on trial tools and procurement before end-of-quarter closes. Read if you manage budget lines.
nina (Finance): 1) Trials under $1,000 can be charged to team p-card with Concur note + project tag.
omar (Growth): Our outreach tool trial is $750, ok to buy on p-card?
nina (Finance): yes @omar, p-card + Concur note. Keep receipts.
mike (Eng): We have a short-term sandbox for load testing (est $1,200). That falls over the $1k threshold 100? What then?
procure-bot: Quick link: Procurement playbook -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/playbook#trials
nina (Finance): @mike: for $1,200 submit the fast-track PO (select "trial-tool"). We'll approve within 48h if you include justification and owner. If it's infra-critical, mark critical and tag me.
omar (Growth): thanks Nina, will charge and attach note.
mike (Eng): thanks, filing the fast-track now.
nina (Finance): Reminder: new vendors > $10k still need the Vendor Risk check. This guidance only applies to short trials and micro-purchases.
procure-bot: Policy snippet: "Trials <= $1,000: p-card. Trials $1,001-$10,000: fast-track PO. >$10k: full onboarding."
